comment: Gating plate + capillary, SRz axis from two measurements of one device (RG_GMC 2026-10-15): SRn 120 / SRz -12 (ST -3.4987, SZ 37.796, SN 0.0004, CPS 60.30) and SRn 92 / SRz -24 (ST -6.0479, SZ 38.988, SN 0.0011, CPS 61.74), SN kept at ~0 and the capillary refocused. Device at plate x 1.51, y 2.82 mm (from the photos), Si substrate H 0.525 mm. Fitted SZ0, SRn axis, SRz offsets and the capillary position; ST0 = 0 and SN_f = 0 kept (2 sets cannot fix them). Exact fit (no redundancy): the SRz offset SN depends on the drawn x (+-0.3 mm in x -> -+1.2 mm); correct the drawing with Found here. CPS increasing moves the capillary towards the sample.
